# M059: exact-version CI tooling for GitHub workflows.
#
# Replaces floating `pip install build pytest pyyaml` / `pip install
# maturin pytest build` steps so the constraint file — not a floating
# registry query — owns the tested graph. Dependabot (`pip`,
# directory `.github/python-ci`) proposes updates; CI installs with
# `pip install -r .github/python-ci/requirements.txt`.
#
# maturin stays exact (native-wheel builds must be reproducible); bumps
# flow through Dependabot and must stay green on the python-native job.
build==1.6.1
maturin==1.16.0
pytest==9.2.0
pyyaml==6.0.3
